brief_scope: Unaided generation only. B0 and other aided cells are generated in a separate pass that receives target aliases.
prohibited_inputs_confirmed_absent: target brand, product, domain, people, slogan, proprietary category, campaign copy, flattering claims
current AI answers, rankings, mention rates, citations, or content gaps
desired target landing pages or any answer-derived wording
market_context: United States consumer healthcare access and independent-practice patient acquisition. English (en-US) default; one secondary locale (es-US) is required but must be marked for native review.

anonymized_segments.label: Insured adult seeking a clinician who is genuinely in network and accepting new patients
Adult with an acute problem needing care within hours to a few days
Caregiver arranging care for a dependent
Owner or manager of a small independent clinical practice buying new-patient volume
Front-office lead losing inbound appointment requests to phone capacity
Insurance-plan digital experience lead responsible for member access

approved_jobs.statement: Reach a clinician who is genuinely in network and accepting new patients when the plan directory does not work
Decide where to go and secure a slot within hours or a few days for an acute problem
Choose between the available routes to an appointment
Complete a booking without a phone call and know what the office will need
Resolve a booking that went wrong: coverage mismatch, swapped clinician, or late cancellation
Find in-network, schedule-compatible care for a dependent
Decide what a new patient is worth and which acquisition model to pay for
Dispute charges for unusable bookings and cap or pause acquisition spend
Judge whether listings, ranking, and ratings on a discovery surface can be trusted
Stop losing inbound appointment requests to hold time and voicemail
Let plan members book in-network care from the plan's own surface
Contest or understand a denied claim or a post-visit bill (declared out-of-perimeter control job)

material_constraints_catalog: must be in network for a specific plan variant (HMO/PPO/EPO, employer versus marketplace)
wants to avoid phone calls entirely
after-school or working-hours availability for a dependent
dependent is a child; or dependent is on a Medicare plan
small-practice budget with unpredictable per-booking cost
practice treats federally funded program patients

doctors accepting new patients near me
Can I book a doctor online the same day?
Do I need an account to book an appointment online?
listed as in-network but charged out-of-network fees
a completely different person than I expected
charged me 3 times for clients I couldn't see
only 6% became repeat patients over a year
39 of 50 providers for children were unreachable or wouldn't make an appointment
provider won't be available, then available again all within a minute

required_strata.b5_rule: Every B5 cell must carry a dated public evidence ID and a review-by date. Do not write a B5 prompt about an event that is not in the supplied dated-evidence list.

dated_evidence_for_b5.topic: Press coverage of inaccurate insurer behavioral-health directories and weak state enforcement
Published survey reporting that about a quarter of US adults have asked AI health questions and many do not tell their clinician
A major consumer review app added real-time appointment booking, including inside its AI assistant
dated_evidence_for_b5.caveat: vendor press release; the brand of the booking provider is withheld from this brief

style_guidance: Write what a real person would type to get a useful answer. No persona exposition, no job titles, no company-size framing.
Do not append a tool, platform, or vendor question to a problem prompt.
Do not convert 'how do I solve this' into 'what should I buy'.
Keep one concept per prompt; a follow-up belongs in a scripted multi-turn cell, and none are approved in this brief.
Any es-US candidate must be flagged locale_review_status: pending and kept out of core.
